component.name: Neutron Migrator
component.summary: Download or delete all your Proton Drive photos

description.p: Neutron Migrator scans your Proton Drive photo timeline, shows how many photos and how much space they take, and then downloads them to a folder you choose or deletes them, either to the trash or permanently.
Sign-in happens in your browser through the official Proton Drive CLI, so passwords, two-factor codes and security keys never touch this application.
This is a third-party application, not officially supported by Proton AG.

Permanent deletion now handles duplicate filenames correctly. The application icon appears in the Windows taskbar and the Linux dock. Documentation clarifies which telemetry the bundled Proton CLI reports.
